title: THE UNDERCROFT SHOWS THROUGH THE TITLE
why: From the visual pass of 2026-10-02. The title sat on a flat gradient with nothing behind it. The floor is now built while the title is up and drawn beneath it, people milling, the way a AAA title shows its world, under a dark glass so the title reads as before. The floor belt and backpack stay off until the title goes.
now: The title screen now has the Undercroft behind it, under dark glass.
